newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amcor sees paper price rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amcor sees paper price rise in 1997.

text.p: Amcor Ltd managing director Don Macfarlane said on Monday the paper and packaging group hoped to see signs of an increase in world paper prices from the first half of calendar 1997.

"We can't see much likelihood of a change in the first half of the year (1996/97)...but we do believe the fall has stopped and one would hope that in the first half of (calendar) 1997 we will start to see some signs of paper prices moving upwards," he said.
Amcor blamed a roughly 20 percent downturn in world paper prices in the second half of 1995/96 (July-June) for much of the group's fall in annual earnings.
Amcor on Monday posted a net profit of A$338.8 million in 1995/96, down six percent from A$359.7 million in 1994/95, and a 15.6 percent drop in pre-tax operating profit to A$519.7 million.
It kept its final dividend unchanged at 20 cents.
